title: First reference pipeline on an openly-licensed sample (validate->report->export), reproducible
context: This first reference pipeline proves the validation + standards-I/O spine end-to-end on an openly-licensed sample and demonstrates the byte-identical reproducibility invariant on a real run. It uses only an openly-licensed (e.g. CC0) sample; no partner or sensitive data is involved. Processed-data output license follows the source. Depends on csp-validate-005 and csp-adapter-007.
objective: Author and run a reference PipelineSpec (validate -> report -> export) on an openly-licensed sample dataset that reproduces byte-identically and emits a before/after error-rate plus a complete provenance manifest.
acceptanceCriteria: Reference pipeline runs validate -> report -> export on an openly-licensed sample end-to-end
Run reproduces byte-identically on independent replay (double-run verified)
ValidationReport emits a before/after error-rate pair
Output is standards-conformant (DwC/Frictionless) and carries a complete provenance manifest; output license follows the source dataset license
output: /output/reference-pipeline-018/ containing the PipelineSpec, the standards-conformant cleaned/validated output, the run manifest, and the before/after error-rate report.
outputLicense: Follows source dataset license (e.g. CC0/CC-BY); recorded per run
